name: Nikutai Choukyou Toriko Tsuma
source:
"I see. It's been a month since Miki has gone away..."
The wedding ring she left behind is sitting on her makeup table.
Ever since, I've been looking at it with a complex of emotions.
Then, in my sentimentality, I found a secret diary and a link to some website.

[Edited from [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE036491.html]DLsite english[/url]]
